additionalInfo.description: Rule chain phu tro cho time-based automations. Tao 1 device type 'scheduler' gui heartbeat moi phut. Rule chain nay nhan heartbeat va chuyen sang Automation Engine de evaluate time-based rules. Cach dung: tao 1 device co type='scheduler', gui telemetry {heartbeat: true} moi 60 giay.
Kiem tra message co phai heartbeat khong
Lay danh sach Home Asset IDs tu Customer attribute. Customer can co server attribute 'home_asset_ids' la JSON array cac home asset ID.
Enrich heartbeat message voi time context de Automation Engine evaluate time-based rules
Chuyen sang SmartHome Automation Engine rule chain. Can set targetRuleChainId sau khi import.
